answer.summary: Two ArchUnit repository-access rules in TenantActiveTableAccessArchTest fail deterministically: LocalObjectService (xtm.counterpart) has a repository field and calls ExerciseRepository and ScenarioRepository methods outside the allowed API classes. The change touched GraphLandingService.java, not LocalObjectService, so the log does not show this PR causing it, but the failure is structural and will repeat on rerun. Check whether the rule allow-list or LocalObjectService changed, or whether main already fails the same way.
